Probate-Morgan
Preserved Primary Document • probt-m2.htm
Be it remembered that on the twenty second Day of October in the year of our Lord, One thousand eight hundred and thirty three, Letters of Administration on the estate of John Morgan deceased were granted to Joseph Stafford of Talbot County in the state of Maryland who married Sophia one of the daughters of the said John Morgan, deceased and who being sworn gave bond with John Hudson his surety in the penal (?) sum of One thousand Dollars. Warrant of appraisment isssued to John Booth and John Baynard.
(signed by) Wm. Ridgeley, reg.
